# MTechZilla

> MTechZilla is an offshore software development company helping US and EU product and engineering teams build and scale since 2021. We provide senior dedicated developers from India, full dedicated development teams, and end-to-end software outsourcing across React, Next.js, Node.js, React Native, AWS, and AI.

Founded in 2021, MTechZilla has shipped 30+ products used by 1M+ users and helped clients raise $10M+ in funding. Recognized by Clutch, GoodFirms, MobileAppDaily, Peekwire, and the AWS Partner Network. Our clients span industries including travel & hospitality, electric vehicles, real estate, renewable energy, insurance, education, and government. 95% of our clients partner with us for 3+ years.

- Headquarters: 2093 Philadelphia Pike 1602, Claymont, DE 19703, USA
- Founder & CEO: Sharvin Shah
- Team Size: 30+ members
- Contact: sales@mtechzilla.com
- Website: https://www.mtechzilla.com

## Markdown access for LLMs

Every page on this site has a markdown variant. Append `.md` to any URL listed below to fetch a clean, LLM-friendly markdown version of that page — for example, https://www.mtechzilla.com/contact.md or https://www.mtechzilla.com/services/web-development.md. The home page is available at https://www.mtechzilla.com/index.md. You can also send `Accept: text/markdown` to any URL for the same effect.

## Our Work

- [Emergency Hotel Booking Platform](https://www.mtechzilla.com/our-work/emergency-hotel-booking-platform): Platform enabling social service agencies to book hotel stays under aliases for vulnerable populations. 700+ agencies onboarded, 500K+ safe nights, 15K+ hotel partners.
- [EV Charging Infrastructure Platform](https://www.mtechzilla.com/our-work/ev-charging-infrastructure-platform): Full-stack EV charging platform for Swiss startup. 5,000+ chargers, 1M+ monthly charging sessions, 10K+ active users.
- [Short-Term Furnished Housing](https://www.mtechzilla.com/our-work/short-term-furnished-housing): Corporate housing website with interactive map search, neighborhood filters, and instant quote requests. Delivered in 2 months.
- [Smart Energy Platform](https://www.mtechzilla.com/our-work/smart-energy-platform): Switzerland's electricity tariff transparency platform covering 600+ energy providers with StromVV-compliant APIs.
- [Instant Shelter Booking Platform](https://www.mtechzilla.com/our-work/instant-shelter-booking-platform): Real-time shelter bed availability platform. 20K+ beds managed, 95% reduction in placement time, 700+ agencies connected.
- [Fair Rental Value Platform](https://www.mtechzilla.com/our-work/fair-rental-value-platform): Rental valuation platform covering 10M+ properties across all 50 US states with detailed reports.

## Engagement Models

- **Hire Dedicated Developers** — Senior pre-vetted engineers from India work directly inside your team, attend your standups, and integrate into your tools. Deploy in 7 days. Best for filling skill gaps and scaling fast without local hiring cost. See [IT Staff Augmentation](https://www.mtechzilla.com/it-staff-augmentation-services).
- **Dedicated Development Team** — Complete team with a Tech Lead who owns delivery, runs standups, and reports to you. Best for SaaS, long-term product development, and scaling without local hiring cost.
- **Software Development Outsourcing** — End-to-end project ownership from scoping and architecture through development, QA, and launch. Best for MVPs, platform builds, and fixed-scope projects with defined milestones.

Pricing: dedicated developers from $20/hr, hourly billing. Projects are milestone-based with transparent pricing. Free discovery call. 5-day replacement guarantee. Minimum 4-hour US timezone overlap. 1-month minimum engagement for developers.
